# jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings (Resource)

Manages Jamf Pro App Installer global settings. Singleton — one record per tenant.

Import with `terraform import jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings.<name> singleton`.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read Mac Applications | `read:pro:mac-applications` |
| Update Mac Applications | `update:pro:mac-applications` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jamfplatform_pro_app_installer_settings" "example" {
  deployment_settings = {
    batch_size       = 1000
    batch_frequency  = 60
    days             = ["MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY"]
    server_time_from = "08:00:00Z"
    server_time_to   = "17:00:00Z"
  }

  end_user_experience = {
    notification_frequency  = 2
    notification_message    = "An update is available for this app."
    update_deadline         = 24
    force_quit_message      = "Please save your work. This app will close shortly."
    force_quit_grace_period = 10
    update_complete_message = "The app has been updated successfully."
    relaunch                = true
    suppress                = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `deployment_settings` (Attributes) Controls the batch deployment process for App Installer. Omit to leave the server's existing values untouched. Within this block, omitting a field clears it to null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_settings))
- `end_user_experience` (Attributes) Controls the end-user notifications and deferral experience. Omit to leave the server's existing values untouched. Within this block, omitting a field clears it to null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_user_experience))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.

<a id="nestedatt--deployment_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment_settings`

Optional:

- `batch_frequency` (Number) Minutes between batch deployments. Must be between 10 and 1440.
- `batch_size` (Number) Number of devices per command batch. The UI presents fixed options (100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000) but the server accepts any positive integer.
- `days` (Set of String) Days of the week on which deployments run. `null` means no day restriction; `[]` explicitly clears to no days.
- `server_time_from` (String) Start of the daily deployment window. Format: `HH:MM:SSZ` (UTC, 24-hour). Example: `08:00:00Z`.
- `server_time_to` (String) End of the daily deployment window. Format: `HH:MM:SSZ` (UTC, 24-hour). Example: `17:00:00Z`.


<a id="nestedatt--end_user_experience"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_user_experience`

Optional:

- `force_quit_grace_period` (Number) Minutes the user is given to quit the app before the install proceeds.
- `force_quit_message` (String) Message shown when the user is prompted to quit the app.
- `notification_frequency` (Number) Hours between repeat notifications while the update is pending.
- `notification_message` (String) Message shown when the update notification first appears.
- `relaunch` (Boolean) Whether to relaunch the app automatically after the update completes.
- `suppress` (Boolean) Whether to suppress notifications for this update.
- `update_complete_message` (String) Message shown when the installation completes.
- `update_deadline` (Number) Hours the user may defer before the install is forced.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
